name: cortex-medical-academy
description: Cortex Medical Academy: a static, no-build study site (MCAT, clinical scenarios, anatomy, medicine, neuroengineering).

scripts.check: python3 scripts/build-academy-curriculum.py --check && python3 scripts/build-neuro-projects.py --check && python3 scripts/build-offline-manifest.py --check && node scripts/check-clinical-longitudinal.cjs > /dev/null && node scripts/check-clinical-rotations.cjs > /dev/null && node scripts/check-mcat-item-history.cjs > /dev/null && node scripts/check-mcat-rehearsals.cjs > /dev/null
scripts.check:content: for f in scripts/check-*.cjs; do node "$f" > /dev/null || echo "FAIL $f"; done
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run check
